threads.name: The Influence of Francis Bartlett's Donations
threads.description: This theme explores the significant impact of Francis Bartlett's donations on the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston. It begins with the acquisition of a two-handled jar and a bronze statue of Mantiklos 'Apollo' in 1900, turns with the purchase of a sarcophagus or large urn in 1912, and pays off with the continued presence of these pieces in the museum's collection, highlighting the lasting legacy of Bartlett's contributions.

threads.name: The Evolution of the Museum's Collection
threads.description: This theme traces the development of the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston's collection through significant acquisitions and donations. It starts with the museum's founding and early acquisitions in the 19th century, turns with the addition of the Wan-go H. C. Weng Collection in the 21st century, and culminates in the diverse and rich collection that the museum boasts today.

threads.name: Patronage and Philanthropy in Art Acquisition
threads.description: This theme highlights the role of patronage and philanthropy in the growth of the museum's collection. It begins with Maria Antoinette Evans Hunt's funding of a new wing, turns with the donations from the Loïs Mailou Jones Pierre-Noël Trust and John Goelet, and pays off with the museum's ability to house and display a wide array of artworks thanks to these generous contributions.
